summary: V3 Part B (Backtesting) + Part A regression tested end-to-end. 24/24 backend API tests pass against the public URL (options contract, coverage swing 2026 and past ranges, prepare→422 MOCK message, 8 validation rejections, swing run lifecycle + metric keys, entry-after-signal invariant, run-identity reuse, slippage mutation creates new id, zero-cost GROSS warning + gross==net, positive costs net<gross, intraday 15m no-overnight hold, list runs, 404 for random/invalid uuid, 21/21 SYNTHETIC strategy evals, knowledge upload→research→citations→delete). Frontend /backtesting verified: nav-backtesting present, bt-mock-mode-banner shown, mode toggle flips interval options to [15m,5m], Check-data populates bt-coverage-row rows + warnings, Prepare shows MOCK-mode error toast, Run completes to 'completed' with bt-synthetic-banner + bt-metrics + bt-provenance + run-list rows, strategy-evals-run-btn → '21/21 passed'. Dashboard, Stock Analysis, Scanner, EVALS, Settings, Research all load without console errors.

minor.issue: Coverage row uses field name 'warmup_bars' while the review-request spec documents it as 'warmup'. Not a bug (frontend consumes the actual field), but the public contract wording in the task is slightly off. Suggest aligning docs or the field name.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Decide whether to rename coverage field 'warmup_bars' → 'warmup' or update docs/STRATEGY_EVALUATION.md to match current API.
critical_code_review_comments: service.py:_execute — synthetic flag is derived from coverage rows (c.get('synthetic')); confirmed propagates to run.synthetic_data=true for all MOCK runs tested.
engine.simulate_exit — stop-first ordering on ambiguous bars honoured; limit-fill bars suppress target hit (good no-look-ahead posture).
api.py _bt wrapper correctly surfaces BacktestError as 422 and ValueError/KeyError as 422 with a prefixed message.

In MOCK mode with past date range (e.g. 2025-01-01 → 2025-10-01) warehouse only has recent synthetic candles, so warm-up gating returns 0 trades. Backend still returns completed+synthetic warnings; UI correctly hides equity curve and shows coverage warnings. Expected behaviour but worth noting for demo UX.
Request-identity hashing includes slippage/cost via assumptions — verified identical requests reuse id and slippage mutation creates new id.
GET /api/backtests/<non-uuid> uses try/except in get_run returning None → 404; good.
seed_data_creation: Transient: uploaded TEST_reliance_note.txt via /api/knowledge/upload and deleted it in the research regression test. Multiple backtest runs created by API tests remain in backtest.runs table (all MOCK/synthetic).
context_for_next_testing_agent: System clock inside the container is 2026-10-10; the 'future end-date' rejection is relative to this date. Mock market provider's stored candle window is short (~1 month), so past multi-month ranges often produce 0 trades with warm-up warnings - this is correct behaviour. Backtest execution is a background asyncio task; poll /api/backtests/{id} every ~2s. Reuse-identity key depends on {mode,interval,symbols,start,end,capital,risk_per_trade_pct,slippage_bps,cost_bps_per_side} plus versions + data_versions. Frontend file at /app/frontend/src/pages/Backtesting.jsx uses data-testid prefixes bt-* and strategy-evals-*; nav uses /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx data-testid='nav-backtesting'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The one minor discrepancy (coverage field name 'warmup_bars' vs 'warmup' in review-request wording) is a documentation/contract-wording issue, not a defect.
